title: The many arrangers in Basie's band
summary: Dance notes the band used many arrangers, including Dickie Wells, Andy Gibson and Buster Harding, yet kept its character.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: All this time though you were having, I mean the difference between this band and we'll say Duke's or Luncefords was that there were a whole lot of different arrangers coming in all the time?
I mean you were doing something, Dickie Wells was doing something, Andy Gibson, Buster Harding.
We had a whole staff of guys that......
But the character of the band was still sort of always obvious wasn't it?
